headword: {学籍番号|がくせきばんごう}

definitions.explanation: A unique number assigned to each student upon enrollment at a school or university, used for administrative purposes such as exams, records, and identification.

examples.japanese: {学籍番号|がくせきばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in your student ID number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{答案用紙|とうあんようし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{学籍番号|がくせきばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote my name and student ID number on the exam answer sheet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}する→入学する：01851_nyuugakusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{学籍番号|がくせきばんごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}り{当|あ}てられ→割り当てる：11873_wariateru⟧、⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{管理|かんり}される→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧。
examples.english: Upon enrollment, a student ID number is assigned, and you are managed under that number until graduation.

notes:
USAGE:
{学籍番号|がくせきばんごう} is a compound of ⟦{学籍|がくせき}→学籍：16640_gakuseki⟧ (student registration/enrollment) and ⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧ (number). It is used primarily in university and school contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学籍番号|がくせきばんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to fill in one's student ID number)
- {学籍番号|がくせきばんごう}⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧ (in order of student ID number)
- {学籍番号|がくせきばんごう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to search by student ID number)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{出席番号|しゅっせきばんごう} (attendance number) is a similar concept used in elementary and secondary schools, typically assigned in alphabetical order by surname.
